C1281.title: Shanghai Police Crack Down on AI-Powered Article Spinning Harming Business Interests
C1281.summary: In 2025, professional self-media operator Yao hired Lu to use AI tools to generate false articles about a tea beverage company and publish them across more than ten accounts, causing revenue declines at some stores. Another suspect, Chen, used AI tools to rewrite online rumors to promote AI training courses. Shanghai police took compulsory criminal measures against Yao and seven others.
